m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Young Wizard, I told you I knew what you were up to. You wish to save the Bees? How, when you can't even save yourself?
Witness a fraction of the power of the Song of Creation.
Spellbinder... what have you done to me? A fever courses through my veins, and a hunger burns within my mind!
I must admit I admire the Brood Mother's purity. A survivor, unclouded by conscience, remorse, or delusions of morality.
I hope her poison lets you live long enough to experience a truly painful and wretched death.
Spellbinder... is that you? I was swallowed by the Shadow, and you have saved my spirit a second time!
Do you have the Moon's Crown? I see it is broken and missing a gem, but it still has much magic within it.
Quickly! Use the Moon's Crown to force me to shed the Shadow Queen's skin!
Spellbinder, let the power of the Moon's Crown flow over me and wash away this crass and brutal form.
Spellbinder, the good you have done this day is invaluable!
Spellbinder, I am restored! And yet... the blood pounds beneath my antennae.
Spellbinder... do you feel that cold wind blowing?
I have been abuzz since you left, barely able to contain my... emotions. I fear the Shadow Queen's wrath, but I cannot live like this.
Bring the Moon's Crown into the Royal Queen's Chamber and let us see if we can master its use.
Take the Moon's Crown into the Royal Queen's Chamber so we can attempt to master its magic!
